deadline.value: International applicants should apply by December 1, 2026 for priority review; the standard deadline is June 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: Fall - Priority U.S. CITIZEN December 1 INTERNATIONAL December 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE is required, so there is no subject test.

gre_general.value: No GRE General score is required.

supervisor.value: Admission does not need a supervisor; the dissertation advisor is chosen after laboratory rotations.
supervisor.quote: A student will select their dissertation advisor, who will serve as their dissertation committee chair, following laboratory rotations

funding.value: No funding statement on the program pages.

entry_route.value: Applicants can enter with a bachelor's degree in a related field, and a master's can be credited with up to 21 credits.
entry_route.quote: Baccalaureate degree in chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, or a closely related discipline from a regionally accredited university | students who have earned a master’s degree or completed some graduate coursework at an accredited college or university may apply to have up to 21 credits applied toward their degree

name: Integrated Molecular and Biophysical Chemistry PhD
